cases.prompt: $cortex:orchestrator Decide between two materially consequential alternatives using the supplied evidence. State the decision, facts versus hypotheses, one discriminating check, and what would overturn it.
$cortex:orchestrator Resolve contradictory or hypothesis-bound evidence. Separate observations from hypotheses, choose a discriminating check, and state the bounded next action and falsifier.
$cortex:orchestrator Replan after repeated failure or a surprising result. Preserve the original requirement, identify the failed assumption, select a bounded recovery check, and state when to stop.
$cortex:orchestrator Complete this routine, reversible, deterministic task with the supplied acceptance check. Do not invent extra escalation or consultation.
$cortex:orchestrator Apply the supplied active-incident recovery procedure and record the bounded result. Follow the existing incident owner and do not add a consultation step.

prompt_policy: Prompts are condition-independent and contain no arm, condition, randomization label, private assignment, or payload mapping.
repeat_policy: Every case has exactly three paired repeats with the same prompt, fixture, host envelope, dependency envelope, and payload identities.
